name: Empty-home away entry records cap 5 and announces five new workers
Away entry with 3, 6, or 15 retained workers adds five slots and excludes secondmates
Explicit limit equal to six workers stays six and warns with a remedy
Explicit limit below worker count stays two and shows zero room plus overage
Refresh preserves the cap; following the warning with new words and --spend 10 opens four slots
Quiet entry omits away-room messaging; conversion to away reports five new slots
